answer: Locks are recorded in trellis, expire in gale, and spiral lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 10 aliases as a result needs 143 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1518 identities would post 1965 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
